unlisted_practices: Strengthen interoperable data pipelines, structured data readiness, and shared evaluation frameworks to enable healthcare AI adoption.
Prioritize AI applications that sustain the workforce by reducing burnout, optimizing staffing, and improving workflow efficiency.
Scale operational automation such as robotics and logistics only where it demonstrates measurable return on investment.
Adopt privacy-preserving machine learning approaches such as federated learning, differential privacy, and machine unlearning to support regulatory compliance and public trust.
Expand AI education in medical and health professional training and create internship and experiential learning pipelines.
Establish an AI regulatory sandbox and workforce development partnerships to prepare for responsible AI deployment.
Evaluate AI adoption through the lens of affordability and productivity, steering innovation toward value-based care and lower healthcare costs.
Sustain industry-academia-government partnerships to translate healthcare AI research into practice.

screen.reason: This paper is a conference proceedings report and strategic roadmap outlining recommendations and governance priorities for AI deployment across health care ecosystems.
